gloss: by-election; special election (to fill a vacancy)

definitions.gloss: by-election; special election (to fill a vacancy)
definitions.explanation: An election held to fill a seat in a legislative body that has become vacant due to the death, resignation, or disqualification of the incumbent. Common in Japanese political news coverage.

examples.japanese: {補欠|ほけつ}{選挙|せんきょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{辞職|じしょく}→辞職：06157_jishoku⟧⟦に{伴|ともな}い→に伴い：06804_nitomonai⟧、{補欠|ほけつ}{選挙|せんきょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実施|じっし}される→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧。
examples.english: A by-election will be held following the legislator's resignation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{参議院|さんぎいん}→参議院：15158_sangiin⟧{補欠|ほけつ}{選挙|せんきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{五人|ごにん}→五人：30567_gonin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{名乗|なの}り→名乗り：10661_nanori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げている→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: Five candidates have announced their intention to run in next month's House of Councillors by-election.

notes:
An election held to fill a vacant seat in a legislative body. Vacancies typically arise from death, resignation, or disqualification of an elected official. Often abbreviated to {補選|ほせん} in news headlines and casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {補欠|ほけつ}{選挙|せんきょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧: to hold a by-election
- {補欠|ほけつ}{選挙|せんきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立候補|りっこうほ}→立候補：13778_rikkouho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to run in a by-election
- ⟦{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}→衆議院：14153_shuugiin⟧/⟦{参議院|さんぎいん}→参議院：15158_sangiin⟧{補欠|ほけつ}{選挙|せんきょ}: House of Representatives/Councillors by-election

FORMS:
- {補選|ほせん} — short form, very common in media

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {総選挙|そうせんきょ} — general election (all seats at once)
- ⟦{統一|とういつ}→統一：04551_touitsu⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧ — unified local elections
- {再選挙|さいせんきょ} — re-election (when the original election was invalid)
